meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码改动变成讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要向团队讲解代码改动
copy.tagline_en: Turn code changes into an explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain code changes to others

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把一个 GitHub 拉取请求(PR 链接、owner/repo#N 或「this PR」)变成一段代码改动讲解视频:根据改动内容、提交记录和涉及文件,规划分镜、配旁白,逐帧渲染出 mp4。
howto.when: 当你给出 GitHub 拉取请求(PR 链接、owner/repo#N 或「this PR」)并要把它做成讲解视频(更新日志、功能展示、修复讲解等)时;产品宣传或无 PR 的选题不走这里。

say.text: 把 owner/repo#12 这个 PR 做成代码讲解视频
say.note: 会读取该 PR 的改动与提交,先出分镜脚本再渲染。

say.text: 用当前仓库里的 this PR 生成修复讲解视频
say.note: 适合已检出仓库的场景,直接基于当前代码改动。

say.text: 把这个 PR 做成更新日志风格的讲解视频
say.note: 叙事按更新日志组织,不按文件顺序罗列改动。

howto.what_en: Turns a GitHub PR (URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a repo) into a code-change explainer video: fetch via gh, plan storyboard/script, generate narration, render frames, output mp4 — changelog, feature reveal, or fix walkthrough.
howto.when_en: When the user gives a GitHub PR (URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a repo) and asks for a code-change explainer video (changelog, feature reveal, fix, etc.). Unclear → /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Make a code explainer video for owner/repo#12.
say_en.note: Claude fetches the PR diff and drafts the storyboard first.

say_en.text: Use this PR in the current repo to make a fix explainer.
say_en.note: For a checked-out repo; works from the current change.

say_en.text: Make a changelog-style video for this pull request.
say_en.note: Narrative follows the changelog archetype, not file order.
